calculation.expression: -(close / close.shift(60) - 1) / (negative_daily_return.rolling(90, min_periods=45).std() * sqrt(252) + 1e-8), winsorized cross-sectionally at 5% and 95%
calculation.description: Fades the trailing 60-session return, scaling the reversal signal by trailing downside volatility over 90 sessions. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted reversal opportunity. Signal is causal through the decision-date prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Weak in 2020-2024 (IC -0.00510), improving in 2025-2027 (0.01604), positive in 2028-2029 (0.03061), and very strong in 2030-2032 (0.13891). Small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation; robustness is supported by 2,561 dates and average 14.12 instruments.
